method: net_supply = circ_now - burned_tokens + unlocked_tokens; burn at trailing-90d rate (constant token rate); unlocks from DefiLlama emissions schedule when available else trailing-90d realized unlock/issuance rate. bought_not_burned = treasury buybacks (not subtracted from net_supply; see net_float_ex_treasury_buys).

flags: Base case uses DefiLlama-documented realized unlocks (core-contributor monthly + validator rewards, trailing 90d). Hyperliquid API (tokenDetails) lists 237.9M HYPE at non-circulating 0x43e9..a251 and futureEmissions 410.8M; if 237.9M vested linearly to end-2027 (DefiLlama note) unlocks would be ~0.53M/day = ~20x the base case. Treat base case as LOWER bound for dilution.
HYPE.burn_basis: DefiLlama holdersRevenue last-90d avg / daily price
HYPE.unlock_basis: DefiLlama emissions: no forward schedule -> trailing-90d realized unlock rate extrapolated
